ops.title: Keep CCX symbol lookup inside its requested source scope
ops.description:
Confirmed source scope bug from the retained owned rg37284 incident. Exact ccx code symbol WithScope --body -g /Users/yasyf/go/pkg/mod/github.com/yasyf/cc-notes@v0.74.40/internal/store/scope.go --budget 900 ran from home. A missing explicit anchor produced an empty structural outline, then text fallback dropped the operand because AnchorGrepArgs returns none on stat failure. The resulting rg command recursively searched cwd. Evidence: FE/native-ccn040-source-lookup-own-child-cancellation.json SHA602238d8 and review9bd8b27a. Source at f270de58 matches this mechanism; no real-home reproduction is permitted.
Owner: /root/ccn_anchor_source_peer <ccn-anchor-source-peer@codex.local>. Root reconciles/publishes uncommitted source; C1 coordinates sole official CCX carrier/install. Existing corpus/stack fixes stay independent.
Next executable step: finish minimal scope-preserving correction in isolated ccx-symbol-lookup-scope, author private fake-engine subprocess/argv regression and immutable old-code negative, then freeze exact source packet for independent review and hosted CI. Preserve valid targeted/project behavior. No local tests/builds, new timeout/cap/retry, real-home scan, protected process actions or default-helper control.

ops.text: A missing explicit anchored file or directory never broadens a symbol or grep search; private fake-engine argv controls demonstrate the exact old failure and corrected bounded operand.
An unscoped symbol lookup rooted at home refuses before recursive engines; valid targeted and non-home project lookups retain structural/degraded/reference behavior.
Independent exact-source review and full hosted CI pass on both operating systems, including required scope regressions and an immutable old-source negative; no local test or real-home reproduction.
Root normal merge and C1 coordinated official containing carrier, supported install and private affected-operation verification are retained before normal task completion.
